lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The Basin, 2031. Four hundred hectares of graded sand under a sky with nothing in it. In the middle there is a frame going up, eleven storeys of it so far, and the concrete pour runs through the night under work lamps because the schedule does not stop for dark.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: In my century this site draws four hundred megawatts. Meridian's filings call it a logistics facility. A logistics facility is a warehouse with a car park. You do not cool a warehouse with a river.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: So whatever they are building here, they wrote down something else. That is not a crime yet. It is the kind of thing that becomes one about forty years downstream.

lines.speaker: dax
lines.text: It's a hole in the ground with money going into it. That's it. That's the whole thing.

lines.speaker: dax
lines.text: Everything my lot ever had taken off us started as one of these. Somebody grades the sand, somebody pours it, and in thirty years there's a fence round it and you need permission to walk past.

lines.speaker: wren
lines.text: Eight hundred people are putting it up, and I have asked four of them what it is for. Not one of them could tell me. They are not being secretive. They genuinely have not been told.

lines.speaker: wren
lines.text: Write that down before anything else. The people building the thing did not know what it was. Three hundred years from now that will matter more than the concrete.
